Card Q&A.a: Yes, the  effect allows it to attack.
Card Q&A.q: This card with no digivolution cards can't be suspended because of its [All Turns] effect, but does this card's  effect allow it to attack without suspending?

Effect: ＜Overclock ([Composite] Trait)＞ (At the end of your turn, by deleting 1 of your Tokens or other [Composite] trait Digimon, this Digimon attacks a player without suspending.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By returning 1 Digimon card from your opponent's trash to the top of the deck, return 1 of their Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
[All Turns] This Digimon with no digivolution cards can't suspend and isn't affected by your opponent's effects.
